errors.evidence: The description lists the category "Незаконност" (Illegality), which is not present in the chart. The third category in the chart is "Неизправност" (Malfunction/Fault).

The list of categories from the x-axis is incomplete. It omits three categories that are visible in the chart: "Неизправност" (~20%), "Прекъсване на конкуренцията / пазара" (~19%), and "Интегриране на продукта" (~7%). The first two omissions are particularly significant as they are the third and fourth highest bars.
The description uses the definite form "Веригата за доставки" (The supply chain), whereas the label on the chart is "Верига за доставки" (Supply chain). This is a minor transcription inaccuracy.
